Actual data. An exploratory surface.

Healthy life expectancy (HLE) is the estimated years lived in good health. HLE average here is the mean of male and female estimates, calculated for this project; it is not an ONS statistic. Its approximate 95% range assumes independent errors for men and women and is probably too narrow.

Measures describe areas and use their own definitions, units, denominators and periods. They are linked with HLE in these data; a map cannot establish that one measure is responsible for another. Household deprivation includes a health and disability dimension that overlaps HLE, so it is context only. No model outputs or new datasets are included.

The basemap needs an internet connection. When opened as a local file, OSM tiles may not load because its tile service requires a valid HTTP Referer. On a website, the configurable key-free OSM fallback is available. CARTO styles need your project key.

Adult smoking: OHID Fingertips, Annual Population Survey (indicator 92443), 2022–24 pooled. County and unitary-authority estimates are available for 11 of these 37 authorities; district and neighbourhood estimates are not supplied here.
